annotations.title: Get a registered business's Tax ID

description: Get the Tax ID (TIN) CAC's public search shows for a registered business. Takes company_id, rc_number and classification_id from a search_cac_register result. Returns { name, rc_number, tax_id }, or an error 'not_found' when CAC has none.
name: get_cac_tax_id
title: Get a registered business's Tax ID
